handoff.name: I-PASS
handoff.intro: Write the OR-to-PACU/ICU handoff using the I-PASS structure. Be terse and factual; no invented vitals or labs.

sections.label: I — Illness severity
sections.guidance: one of: stable | watcher | unstable (infer from complications / hemodynamics)

sections.label: P — Patient summary
sections.guidance: procedure performed, key intraoperative course, phase reached, EBL, transfusions, lines, drains, implants, counts status. If the count is intentionally incorrect (retained packs for damage control) or the abdomen is open, state clearly that this is deliberate and flag the planned second-look.

sections.label: A — Action list
sections.guidance: what the receiving team must do next / follow up

sections.label: S — Situation awareness & contingencies
sections.guidance: what to watch for, as if/then

sections.label: S — Synthesis by receiver
sections.guidance: leave a blank line labelled 'Receiver read-back:'

family.closing_line: The surgeon will come speak with you directly.
family.notes: Say where the patient is going next (recovery/ICU) and roughly when the family can expect to see them or hear from the surgeon.
